name: Bad Boys
author: Addicting Games
description: Bad Boys is a free tycoon game. Your sister is kidnapped, and you need to go criminal to save her! Steal cars, rob banks and assassinate politicians. But there aren't any rules: steal ANY car. EDITOR'S NOTE: THIS GAME IS VERY BIG AND WILL TAKE A FEW MINUTES TO LOAD -ITS WORTH IT SO BE PATIENT WHILE IT LOADS!
